# Test evidence

The short/long reference videos and joint arrays are captured from the CC0
Quaternius mannequin. They test timeline validation and input binding. The short
workflow has local file names and no embedded private ground-truth payload.
The dance ground truth tests explicit GT selection, not agreement with PickUp.
Its meta.source blob URL is an opaque historical identifier, not a runtime URL.

The two FAIL report snapshots test the HTTP/gate decision with synthetic file
bytes and fresh hashes. That test is not new video analysis. The representative
cached-pose reanalysis lives separately in public_samples/cached-6b7a.
